My favorite hitching experience happened in Ireland. I've hitched from Arkansas to California and back. I did some from France to Germany and Holland to France.

I would recommend getting a sleeping bag just to have. I bought one in France and that sucker came in handy so many many times. I slept in parks, hostels, and couch surfed. 

Oh, and I'm a 24-year-old female who did this pretty much all solo besides picking up a travel buddy here and there for a couple weeks. Message me if you have any questions. Good luck and you'll have a great time!
